'''Sanner''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who was present at the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] in the [[Glacial Trespass]] area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Glacial">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Glacial Trespass]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> around [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sanner first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
